name: WhisperAloud
description: Top-bar indicator for WhisperAloud offline dictation: shows whether the daemon, speech model and global hotkey are ready, and toggles recording without opening the window. Types the dictated text into the focused app; when an app cannot take typed input it puts the text on the clipboard and pastes it (only text sent by the WhisperAloud daemon; the clipboard is never read). Requires the WhisperAloud app (native or Flatpak).
